SLIMEBOSS-BRUISER_SLIME.name: Bruiser Slime
SLIMEBOSS-MIRE_SLIME.name: Mire Slime
SLIMEBOSS-GHOSTFLAME_SLIME.name: Ghostflame Slime
SLIMEBOSS-INSULTING_SLIME.name: Insulting Slime
SLIMEBOSS-ANCIENT_SLIME.name: Ancient Slime
SLIMEBOSS-SPIKY_SLIME.name: Protector Slime
SLIMEBOSS-TIME_SLIME.name: Time Slime
SLIMEBOSS-ANCIENT_SLIME.description:
Deals [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage.
Causes you to draw {Cards:plural:an additional card|[blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] additional cards} each turn.
Draw does not scale with [gold]Potency[/gold].
SLIMEBOSS-TORCHHEAD_SLIME.description:
Deals [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage.
Gains damage from your [gold]Strength[/gold].
SLIMEBOSS-BRUISER_SLIME.description: Deals [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to a random enemy twice.
SLIMEBOSS-SPIKY_SLIME.description: Does not attack. Instead, grants [blue]{Slime:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] for a turn.
SLIMEBOSS-BRONZE_SLIME.description:
Deals [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
After attacking, goes to sleep for [blue]{Sleep:diff()}[/blue] turns.
SLIMEBOSS-CULTIST_SLIME.description:
Deals [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage.
Increases its damage by 1 for every Power or Slime played this combat.
SLIMEBOSS-PSYCHIC_SLIME.name: Psychic Slime
SLIMEBOSS-PSYCHIC_SLIME.description:
Deals [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
Draws a card whenever you draw another Slime or Power card.
SLIMEBOSS-TAUNTING_SLIME.name: Taunting Slime
SLIMEBOSS-MASSIVE_SLIME.name: Massive Slime
SLIMEBOSS-MASSIVE_SLIME.description:
Deals [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
After attacking, goes to sleep for [blue]{Sleep:diff()}[/blue] turns.
SLIMEBOSS-ROYAL_SLIME.name: Royal Slime
SLIMEBOSS-ROYAL_SLIME.description: At the end of your turn, deals [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to a random enemy once for each Slime you've split into.
SLIMEBOSS-MUSCLE_SLIME.name: Muscle Slime
SLIMEBOSS-MUSCLE_SLIME.description:
Deals [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to whichever enemy was attacked last.
Gain [gold]Potency[/gold] this turn whenever you play an Attack.
SLIMEBOSS-EVOLUTION_SLIME.name: Evolution Slime
SLIMEBOSS-EVOLUTION_SLIME.description:
Evolves each time it attacks, up to 5 times.
Lvl 1: At the end of your turn, deals [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
Lvl 2: Deals [blue]{Damage2:diff()}[/blue] damage instead.
Lvl 3: Attacks ALL enemies.
Lvl 4: Also gains Block equal to half the damage dealt.
Lvl 5: Gains [gold]Potency[/gold] whenever it attacks.
SLIMEBOSS-DARKLING_SLIME.description:
Deals [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
Also attacks whenever another Slime is Commanded.
